selection: 256 evenly spaced candidate rows per canonical group; finite rho_spin>=1e-12,totalrho>=1e-8,sigma_total>=0; 5 density quantile bins x4 |q| quantile bins x3 absolute polarization bins; <=160 evenly spaced rows/bin; sort by original pool index
q_definition: q_sigma=lapl_sigma/[4*(3*pi^2)^(2/3)*(rho_sigma+EPS_RHO)^(5/3)]; unbounded correlation convention; exchange uses exact production spin scaling in model.forward
derivative_conversion: d epsilon/d q_sigma at fixed rho,sigma = d epsilon/d lapl_sigma * q_denominator; rho/sigma controls are raw-coordinate partials, not fixed-q density partials
normalization: fixed subset coordinate IQR clamped at1e-12; normalized derivative=raw coordinate derivative times IQR; q uses fixed-rho chain conversion first; adaptive outputs additionally divide by fixed NN_OUTPUT_SCALE_PBE
evaluation: stored F32 values widened; actual differentiable F64 leaves/model, same model.forward descriptors and F_PBE functional; no regenerated source; diagnostic precision, not an operator objective
richness: covariance of 9 adaptive output-channel derivatives normalized by output scale, on256 fixed rows; flatten 9x7 for all,9x2 for q; eigenvalue rank threshold max(top*1e-10,1e-30); participation ratio; descriptor sensitivity richness only, not full parameter Jacobian
head_structure: one positive-weight sum epsilon backward on first256 fixed rows; head and hidden parameter-gradient norms; no updates

conditional_tangent.allowed_trigger: q normalized RMS P536/P0 <0.2 in >=4/5 seeds, OR zero-head gradient blockage with nonzero head gradients in all5 PBE_HEAD states
conditional_tangent.construction: existing nearPBE head biases; epsilon times raw-state original head weights; all hidden tensors unchanged; no training
conditional_tangent.calibration: same frozen subset adaptive9 MSE; shared epsilon minimizing median across seeds11/23/41 absolute log(MSEcandidate/MSEP536); smaller epsilon tie; no objective geometry used
conditional_tangent.cheap_gate: all physical anchors pass; candidate/P536 subset MSE ratio in[0.25,4] in both seeds11/23; local epsilon deviation RMS <=2*P536 in both; q normalized RMS >=P536 in both and >1e-12; nonzero hidden gradient in both
conditional_tangent.expensive_gate: only if cheap gates pass; at most2 new states seeds11/23; never resume old matrix
